title: [Run] Vim (j,k) feature or other keys combinations to navigate items
summary: A long-standing request asks for optional Vim-style j/k navigation in PowerToys Run results after moving focus from the query field.

judgment.rationale: A maintainer called an optional setting feasible in 2020. Current Run handles Tab/arrows in MainWindow.xaml.cs and result selection in ResultsViewModel, but Tab currently cycles tabs rather than proving the requested focus path. Reconcile this old request and linked navigation issues before a detailed design; this is lightweight triage only.
